On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: What is beside Deer Lake Place?
faq.a: Deer Lake Park, directly east — Burnaby's cultural centre, with the Shadbolt Centre for the Arts, Burnaby Art Gallery, Burnaby Village Museum, Hart House and the lake trails, open dawn to dusk year-round at 6450 Deer Lake Ave.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Deer Lake Place address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. The nearby public schools on the Province's SD41 list are Buckingham Elementary (K–7), 6066 Buckingham Ave, and Burnaby Central Secondary (8–12), 6011 Deer Lake Parkway; the school physically in the pocket, Deer Lake SDA at 5550 Gilpin St, is independent. Catchments are address-based and must be checked in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: Is there SkyTrain in Deer Lake Place?
faq.a: No station sits inside the pocket; Metrotown Station (Expo Line), south-west at Metrotown, is the nearest station for this pocket in the sources read.
